subject: design-technology
title: Plastics & Smart Materials
welcome_lead: Thermoplastics, thermosets and the materials that respond to change.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: plastics, thermoplastics, thermosets, smart materials.
final_note: Plastics changed the world for better and worse.

concepts.def: Plastic that sets permanently when heated.

walkthroughs.body_html: Thermoplastics can be melted and reshaped many times — great for recycling. Examples: PET (bottles), polythene (bags), acrylic (Perspex).
Thermosets set permanently when first heated. Once formed they can't melt again. Bakelite, epoxy resin and melamine (kitchen worktops) are thermosets.
Smart materials respond to inputs. Thermochromic ink changes colour with heat (mood mugs). Shape memory alloys snap back to shape when warmed. LED ink lights up.
